interventions.what: text screen, BIOS data area (0040:0049, 0040:006C) and GOAL.EXE data-segment memory (DS:7B62, DS:7B64, DS:8336, DS:A9FD, the dword DS:A9FF, the commentary ring DS:7C38 and counter DS:80EE, the score DS:9B3C, the names at [DS:9B6C], the delay byte at [DS:A923]+0x3F, two known strings) read from DOSBox-X savestates (Host+S; components Vga and Memory)

a savestate is written at each read, including every read during the match, and one is loaded (Host+L) at the start (vocabulary/interventions.md lists save and load of state as I2; neutrality tested by E004's replays, not assumed)

start_state.restore: fresh DOSBox-X process at cycles=30000 (config sha256 083897d321ed9fe50ca93bbf03ff45765c03c0f2a6e5e5df57aede499ebdc147) with C: mounted from the folder the savestate was made with, recreated from the verified release copy; GOAL run to its title screen; key n to change the screen; then Host+L loads the savestate whose sha256 is given (made by E004's `run.py make-state` at cycles=30000, DOS time 10:01:00 on 10/04/2026: the captain screen of the next match; it carries the DS:A9FF calibrated in that session); polled until the screen digest equals the one stored with it (ba09a09a7d4f7b7674b05c9117d756fa8f1efc0861068cfbc34cf7671b641bcf); DOS clock of this session not set (the restore brings the state's own BIOS ticks, F004)
